title: Information on hover and click
description: Five information gaps from the alpha feedback. (1) The Salvage window says how many commodities it would take. (2) The space combat dialog names the system, not only its number. (3) Selecting an anomaly system explains what the anomaly does, and a legendary planet's ability card sits on its planet card in the system overview. (4) Hovering another player's units shows their unit card, in the system overview, the combat dialog and the invasion dialog, and the board tile tooltip lists each owner's units with their numbers. (5) The technology viewer filters by colour and by what the viewer can research now. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server; regenerated by npm run screenshots -- CG.
